redemption.specialInstructions:
-Pick-up time depends on your hotel location (between 7-8am). The exact time will be provided by 5pm (Thailand time) the day before your trip.
-In case you haven't chosen your accommodation yet, please contact us 1 day before the tour via WhatsApp or on the local number +66 81 415 3549 to provide us with your hotel/pick up point details.
 -AIRBNB + Private Home/Villa customers: You need to inform us your exact location at least 2 days before your tour
• The duration of transfers are approximate, the exact duration will depend on the time of day and traffic conditions

 • Not recommended for participants with serious medical conditions
 • Not recommended for pregnant women

travelerPickup.additionalInfo:
* Please ensure your selected pickup location matches the accommodation where you will be staying.
* Your exact pickup time will be confirmed by 5:00 PM on the day before your tour.
* We provide complimentary pickup and drop-off from anywhere in Phuket, including hotels, resorts, villas, Airbnbs, guesthouses, and hostels.
* If you are staying on Coconut Island (Koh Maphrao), pickup and drop-off will be arranged at Laem Hin Pier or Laem Hin Lagoon Pier, where our team will meet you.

description:

* ⭐ 2,000+ Five-Star Reviews from satisfied travelers
* Brand-New Snorkel Mouthpiece provided for every guest for maximum hygiene
* ‍✈️ Experienced English & Japanese-Speaking Guides with over 10 years of island tour expertise
*Enjoy an exclusive seaview buffet lunch reserved only for V. Marine Tour guests – never shared with other tour operators.

additionalInfo.description: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Subject to favorable weather conditions. If canceled due to poor weather, you will be given the option of an alternative date or full refund.
Cruise ship passengers are not recommended to book group tours due to concern that the time of tender docking at port may not make it on time for tour speedboat departure

Tour program is subject to flexibility due to weather and/or sea conditions. If we cannot visit an island destination due to risk of safety from weather or sea conditions, no partial refund will be provided
Not recommended for people with motion sickness, heart problems, or seasickness

cancellationPolicy.description: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.

itineraryItems.description: Check in at our office and enjoy light refreshments at the Royal Phuket Marina
Swim, snorkel and sunbathe at this beautiful white sand beach

-Enjoy a delicious, seaview lunch buffet of Thai and foreign cuisine in a private section just for V. Marine Tour customers only
-Vegetarian, vegan, pescatarian, gluten free and other special dietary restrictions are available upon request
-Enjoy free time swimming in the pool or relaxing by the beach after lunch
Sightsee local monkeys as they swim, climb and jump around in their natural habitat. Please keep your distance away from monkeys as they are still wild animals and can bite.
Sightsee and learn about the importance of this cave for the island's swallow birds, who are valued for a unique specialty dish, "bird's nest soup."
Visit the emerald green waters of Pileh Lagoon as you are surrounded by tall limestone cliffs. This is a our passengers' favorite part of the tour!

Enjoy 1 hour of free time at the famous beach from the movie “ The Beach “ starring Leonardo DiCaprio.

Important Update: Maya Bay will be temporarily closed from 1 August 2026 to 30 September 2026 for annual ecological restoration.

During this period, we will still cruise by Maya Bay, allowing guests to enjoy the stunning scenery and take beautiful photos from the boat. To ensure you have a fantastic experience, we will also spend additional time at the other highlights on our itinerary, including snorkeling, Pileh Lagoon, Bamboo Island, and other scheduled stops.
Return to marina by 5:00 - 5:30pm then drop off at hotel after tour is finished
